changes: Added a source-grounded host-native architecture contract and dependency inventory covering reusable gem5 GPU/Vega/HSA and host bridge surfaces, current x86/Process/ThreadContext/TLB blockers, and the pinned Triton/runtime boundaries.
Added a deterministic gem5 host-native boundary checker and 4/4 source-inventory tests without changing the existing VEGA_X86 execution path.
Added a public-header-only runtime boundary consumer and dependency audit; the shared CTest matrix passes 16/16 and the focused Clang ASAN boundary test passes 1/1.
Bound the final clean gem5 and self-amdgpu-runtime commits to the CP-0014 prepare journal and canonical EV-0036/EV-0037 evidence while retaining the no-build/no-execution boundary.
limitations: CP-0014 proves a source-grounded architecture/dependency inventory and runtime ABI boundary only. It does not build or link a standalone host-native simulator target, remove VEGA_X86 from the accepted compatibility path, or execute simulator instructions.

The reusable-versus-x86-blocked classification is not compile proof. Process, ThreadContext, SE translation, CPU-port, x86 TLB, System, and Ruby dependencies remain implementation work for P3-HOST-NATIVE-02.
The runtime boundary consumer and dependency audit open no production GPU device and do not map or execute a code object.
P3-CODEOBJ-03-A2 mapping, dynamic AQL/kernarg, queue submission, decoder execution, and an unmodified Triton vecadd remain unproven separate gates.
No HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, model, multi-daemon, hardware, timing, or performance claim is made by this checkpoint.

argv: Build the standalone no-VEGA_X86 host-native target and minimal host adapter
next_action.expected: A standalone host-native target links without VEGA_X86 or x86 CPU/system objects and exercises a minimal host event, page-memory, queue, and signal adapter through the accepted protocol, with no-x86 and no-production-DSO audits and without claiming code-object or Triton execution.
prerequisites: CP-0014 is accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.
The CP-0014 source inventory, runtime ABI boundary, child identities, and no-build/no-execution limitations remain immutable.
SOURCE_LOCK.json and PROJECT_LANES.json remain byte-identical to their accepted anchors.
The standalone adapter must preserve the existing CP8/CP13 wire and gem5 compatibility path, must not fork a second code-object ABI, and must not open production GPU devices.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0014 accepted and preserve the source inventory, runtime ABI consumer/audit, existing VEGA_X86 oracle, frozen protocol, and no-execution boundary if the standalone build or minimal adapter proof fails.

validation.result: Six retained captures bind GPU/Vega build gates, x86/Process/TLB blockers, reusable host/HSA/GPU surfaces, Triton/runtime boundaries, locked inventory identities, and the explicit no-E2E limit.
